selection: 20% legacy + 40% 2024 + 40% 2025-H1 utility (Sharpe + 0.5 annual log growth + max_drawdown); subtract 0.2 dispersion of recent-half-year Sharpe; promote only if recent aggregate Sharpe/return both improve, positive summed short cycle return in both 2024 and 2025-H1, at least 5/3 short cycles in those windows, legacy Sharpe no more than 0.15 below baseline, full DD <=40%, recent DD <=35%.
execution: Hourly completed signals; 1m final fills, 1bps base slip, 8bps sqrt(participation), actual funding and mark-price protections. Proxy uses 1h bars, 2bps slip and zero volume impact.
short_risk: Long priority; short only while the long target is zero. Small risk: cap 0.75x, 1% stop-distance risk budget, 40% vol target; medium: 1.25x, 1.5%, 55%. No averaging down. Fresh event required after 6h cooldown. Funding entry floor -2bps; exit at -4bps. No RSI<=25 or vol_ratio>=2 chasing.
disclosure: All historical data through August 2026 was used by prior V4.4 research. Here the short-module search is restricted to data before July 2025; the later audit is a procedural holdout, not a wholly blind sample. Candidate designs are retrospective. No retuning on the post-freeze audit.
